title: Rubrik Launches Rubrik Agent Cloud for Anthropic's Claude Code
summary: Delivers Runtime Agent Security and Agent Rewind for Code Repository and Agentic Harness Rubrik FORWARD- Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announced Rubrik Agent Cloud (RAC) for Anthropic’s Claude Code and Claude Cowork. Organizations can now deploy Claude-powered agents at scale with observability, control, and the industry’s only agent rewind to reverse unintended actions, and immutable codebase recovery when an incorrect action outruns version control. A new, additional layer of resilience for Claude agents backs up, monitors, and restores the configuration that governs how agents behave. AI agents now write, push, and deploy code autonomously, but enterprise security infrastructure was built assuming humans are always in the loop.
